name: @krmx/root
description: Krmx is a network protocol for realtime multi-user interactions
author: Simon Karman

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix packages/base install && npm --prefix packages/server install && npm --prefix packages/client install && npm --prefix packages/client-react install && npm --prefix packages/state install && npm --prefix packages/docs install
scripts.audit:fix: npm --prefix packages/base audit fix && npm --prefix packages/server audit fix && npm --prefix packages/client audit fix && npm --prefix packages/client-react audit fix && npm --prefix packages/state run audit:fix && npm --prefix packages/docs audit fix && npm run patch
scripts.validate: npm install && .github/tools/version-check.sh && npm run --prefix packages/base validate && npm run --prefix packages/server validate && npm run --prefix packages/client validate && npm run --prefix packages/client-react validate && npm run --prefix packages/state validate && npm run --prefix packages/docs validate
scripts.versions: .github/tools/version-check.sh && npm install && npm --prefix packages/base run postversion && npm --prefix packages/server run postversion && npm --prefix packages/client run postversion && npm --prefix packages/client-react run postversion && npm --prefix packages/state run versions
scripts.patch-all: npm --prefix packages/base version patch && npm --prefix packages/server version patch && npm --prefix packages/client version patch && npm --prefix packages/client-react version patch && .github/tools/version-check.sh
